programs.notes: Ashesi publishes no aggregate cut-off. Its only published WASSCE bar is 'A minimum grade of C6 in each subject is required to apply' across the six scored subjects (Integrated Science, Core Math, Core English and three electives), which is an aggregate of 36. This is a minimum entry requirement, not a competitive cut-off. Admission is holistic: the committee weighs the personal essay, extracurriculars and high school transcript, and shortlisted candidates must pass a personal interview. Ashesi additionally states: 'Students intending to major in Engineering must have taken Physics and Elective/Further Mathematics.'
